content.text:
Implementation is ready for root review. Writer ownership is released; no commit or push.

- Complete typed history, exact per-currency/category summaries, five recent support records, flat DTO and parser.
- Shared compact identity/declarations, summary and date-filtered history with pagination.
- README and entity reference updated.
- Passed 92 Rust library tests, six final entity tests, 29 Playwright tests, Svelte check/build/format and diff checks.
- Clippy has seven existing declaration-loading/CLI diagnostics under Rust 1.98. No introduced diagnostics remain.

Running servers remain available:

- API `59022`, PID `30579`, log `/tmp/exposed-member-api-isolated.log`.
- Vite `5178`, PID `30849`, log `/tmp/exposed-member-vite.log`.

Root owns final spacing polish, independent review, screenshots and commit.
